[Skip to main content](https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/CDAA/child-development-account#main-content) # Child Development Account - SupportGoWhere Child Development Account Share link Special savings account for the child, which can be used for approved areas of child-raising expenditure, including healthcare and preschool fees. SCHEME HIGHLIGHTS - CDA First Step Grant enhanced by $2,000 for eligible Singaporean children - Up to $15,000 in Government co-matching for eligible Singaporean children - Enhancements will apply to eligible Singaporean children born on or after 14 February 2023 Expand all sections About this support | The SG Child Support Package announced at the 2026 National Day Rally will replace the current Baby Bonus Scheme and Large Families Scheme. Those currently on the Baby Bonus Scheme will be automatically transitioned to the Package. In the meantime, existing payouts will continue as usual.
Learn more about the [SG Child Support Package](https://go.gov.sg/sgchildsupportpackage). | The Child Development Account (CDA) is a special savings account for the child, which can be used for defray child-raising costs. The First Step Grant is automatically deposited after the CDA is opened, and subsequent savings will be co-matched by the Government, up to a cap. Eligible Singaporean children born on or after 14 Feb 2023 will qualify for the following enhanced CDA benefits announced at Budget 2023. **Child Development Account First Step Grant:** - $5,000 automatically credited into the CDA upon account opening. **Government co-matching of CDA savings:** - Eligible Singaporean children are entitled to Government co-matching up to a cap of $4,000 for the first child, $7,000 for the second child, $9,000 for the third and fourth child, and $15,000 for the fifth child and beyond. Who is this for? - Child is a Singapore Citizen - Children born on or after 14 Feb 2023 - Parents are lawfully married - Children of unwed parents may be eligible for CDA benefits if they are born on or after 1 September 2016. How to apply? All parents can apply for Baby Bonus Scheme at LifeSG: - [Bundled service](https://www.life.gov.sg/services/birth-registration) together with child’s birth registration - [Direct application](https://www.life.gov.sg/services/baby-bonus) for child who has already registered for birth Where can I find help? [View more details](https://www.life.gov.sg/services/baby-bonus) * * * MSF Consolidated Hotline: 1800 111 2222 (say ‘Baby Bonus’ when asked for the hotline you want to reach) Operating hours: Mon to Fri 8.30am to 6pm \| Saturday: 8.30am to 1pm (Closed on Public Holidays) _Airtime charges apply for mobile calls to 1800 service lines_ * * * [Submit an enquiry through Ask Baby Bonus](https://ask.gov.sg/msf/questions/new?topic=MSF%20Baby%20Bonus) Scheme last updated 01 Sep 2026 Try our AI search
